newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Mount Polley at 65 pct capacity.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Mount Polley at 65 pct capacity.

text.p: Imperial Metals Corp is currently operating its Mount Polley mine in central British Columbia at 65 percent of its design capacity and is expected to reach full production by September 1, according Geroge White, general manager at the mine.
The mine, which is expected to yield 100,000 ounces of gold and 18 million pounds of copper contained in concentrate annually, began production on June 20, six months ahead of schedule.
The capital cost of start-up was $118 million. Imperial has a 55 percent stake in the mine and Japan's Sumitomo Corp owns the remainder.
Sumitomo will smelt the concentrates in Japan and market the refined copper.
((Derek J. Caney, New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1646))
